stories.title: Shoplifting in Flintshire rose 16% last year as offences fell across Wales
stories.summary: Shoplifting recorded in Flintshire rose by 16% last year, even as it fell across Wales and England, new figures show. North Wales Police recorded 1,054 shoplifting offences in the county in the year to March 2026, up from 909 the year before, according to Office for National Statistics (ONS) data published today. stories.title: Drought status declared for North Wales after wildfires and record-low river flows
stories.summary: Drought has been declared across North Wales, including the river catchments covering Flintshire, after widespread wildfires, record-low river flows and weeks of hot, dry weather. stories.title: North Wales Police renew summer road safety appeal following fatal motorcycle collision
stories.summary: North Wales Police have renewed their summer road safety appeal after 13 fatal collisions on the region’s roads so far this year, seven of them involving motorcycles.
